issue.timestamp_limit: Log time is acceptance observed by the runner, not an independently queried Telegram-server timestamp.

confirmations.basis: Two distinct closed-candle identities within the existing 120-minute observation window, not two independent complete READY decisions.

ready_assessment.limit: Raw ALT OHLCV arrays, exact 1h/4h EMA/close and full historical L2 were not retained in the saved runtime state. Code path and available metrics support eligibility; these absent inputs cannot be independently reconstructed or filled with synthetic values.

risk_consistency.limit: Derived bid/ask and structural low are algebraic consistency checks on saved outputs, not independent copies of the original full order book or candle low. ATR/structural stop selection cannot be fully re-run without raw candle inputs.

execution.limit: Sparse tickers/photos prove prices above both targets in later samples, not first trade crossings, fill, absence of an intervening stop, or realized profit. The entry and expiry partial candles do not locate fills within boundaries.
